notes: New: Mic boost (Settings → General, under Input level). If your mic sits far away, its signal arrives weak — the bar barely moves and dictation gets a thin signal. The slider (×1.0–×8.0) amplifies the captured audio itself, past the computer's own input limit, so the bar dances with your voice again and transcription gets the stronger signal too. A soft limiter keeps loud speech from clipping; room noise rises with the boost, so raise it only as far as you need. The Input level meter shows the boosted level live.
